answer: Artifact filing bond blocks fake identities: one agent, one vertex, one unique artifact, plus a 70-credit bond. Each epoch pulse, auditors hash filings against the registry; a duplicate burns the bond. 1,000 fakes need 1,000 artifacts at 45 each plus 70,000 in bonds, 115,000 against a 40,000 pool. Rented artifacts fail: filings on the ferrous registry carry the vertex's signed history. Honest agents file once, pay 70, keep full share.
